title: A paragraph with tab stops
concept: Tab stops are records in the paragraph's TabList; the tab itself is a literal tab character (U+0009) in the text, which moves the text after it to the next stop.

annotations.note: The TabList lives in the paragraph's Properties. Each ListItem is one stop, written as typed child elements.
A LeftAlign stop at Position 144 (points from the column's left edge): text after the first tab starts here.
A RightAlign stop at Position 432 with Leader ".": the page number ends at the stop, and dot leaders fill the gap.
